card.statement:
If $T(R)$ is a generic tableau and $\mathsf r\in\Specm\Gamma$ corresponds to $R$ then, the unique module $N$ such that
$N(\mathsf r) \neq 0$ is called the irreducible Gelfand--Tsetlin module containing $T(R)$, or simply, the
irreducible module containing $T(R)$.
card.label: Definition 11

paper.title: Irreducible Generic Gelfand-Tsetlin Modules of $\mathfrak{gl}(n)$
paper.abstract: We provide a classification and explicit bases of tableaux of all irreducible generic Gelfand-Tsetlin modules for the Lie algebra $\mathfrak{gl}(n)$.
